nodes.title: Prompt
widgets_values:
Core Actions: The camera flies smoothly over turquoise ocean waters, gradually approaching a pristine white sand beach. A flock of seagulls flies past the camera lens towards the coastline.
Visual Details: Aerial drone shot, cinematic lighting. Bright sunny day, crystal clear turquoise water with gentle white waves crashing on soft, powdery white sand. Lush green palm trees line the edge of the beach. A vibrant red beach umbrella and a white lounge chair stand out against the empty sand.
Audio: The sound of a gentle sea breeze, rhythmic crashing of ocean waves, and distant cries of seagulls. Upbeat, inspiring acoustic guitar music plays in the background to create an inviting vacation atmosphere.
